description: Top, trending, or seasonal rankings. Filterable by genre, tag, and format. "top" returns all-time by score; "trending" returns current week; "seasonal" returns the current or specified ANIME season sorted by popularity; MANGA supports top/trending without season/year filters.

format.description: Format filter; exact blank counts as absent.

genre.description: Genre filter, e.g. "Action", "Romance". Trimmed; blank counts as absent.

media_type.description: Media type to rank. MANGA supports top/trending without season or season_year; broadcast seasons apply only to ANIME.

mode.description: "top": highest-scoring of all time. "trending": most active this week. "seasonal": most popular in the current or specified season/year.

page.description: 1-based page number. AniList serves only the first 5,000 ranked entries, so page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000.

per_page.description: Results per page. Maximum 50; page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000.

anyOf.description: Anime broadcast season. WINTER=Jan–Mar, SPRING=Apr–Jun, SUMMER=Jul–Sep, FALL=Oct–Dec.

season.description: "seasonal" mode: the season to rank, given together with season_year (omit both for the current season). "top"/"trending": restricts the ranking to titles from this season; without season_year it matches that season in every year.

season_year.description: "seasonal" mode: the year to rank, given together with season. "top"/"trending": restricts the ranking to titles from this year.

tag.description: AniList tag filter, e.g. "Isekai", "Found Family". Genres such as "Action" are not tags. Trimmed; blank counts as absent.

name: anime_get_rankings

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `anime_only_season`: MANGA is requested with seasonal mode or a season/season_year filter. `invalid_season`: mode is "seasonal" and exactly one of season / season_year is set. `page_depth_exceeded`: page × per_page reaches past the first 5,000 ranked entries, which AniList refuses to serve. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages are available. Drives pagination; stop when false.

notice.description: Set when entries is empty — echoes the applied mode/filters and how to broaden them, or says the page is past the end of the rankings. Also set on the last page AniList serves (its 5,000-entry reach) while has_next_page is still true.

season_label.description: Season the ranking covers: the ranked season in seasonal mode (e.g. "FALL 2024"), or the season/year filter applied in top or trending mode (e.g. "FALL 2024", "FALL (any year)", "2024"). Null for top or trending without a season filter.

totalCount.description: Exact number of ranked entries, set only on the final page (0 for an empty first page). Use has_next_page to paginate.

total_results.description: Exact number of ranked entries, present only on the final page (has_next_page false) and 0 for an empty first page. Null on every other page.

title: Anime Get Rankings
